INLINE_CODE_SPAN_CARRYING_BB_CODE: an inline code span whose text carries bb code markup stays a markdown code span, because bb code has no inline element that holds its own markup literally; it will render as literal backticks
CODE_BLOCK_CARRYING_THE_BB_CODE_CODE_CLO: a code block whose text contains [/code] stays a markdown fence, because that text would close the bb code block early; it will render as literal backticks
ORDERED_LIST_NOT_STARTING_AT_ONE: an ordered list that does not start at 1 becomes a bb code decimal list, which always restarts at 1
NO_ENABLED_BB_CODE_CARRIES_THIS_CONSTRUC: a markdown construct whose bb code equivalent is not enabled is written as its plain text, because no enabled code carries it
LINK_TITLE_TEXT: the title text of a link or image is dropped, because bb code carries no title attribute
THE_CODES_THE_FLIP_COULD_NOT_CARRY: {codes} stayed as bb code: written as {target} the post did not read the same, and the {target} lane renders bb code as it is, so leaving it costs the post nothing
THE_SEARCH_STOPPED_BEFORE_IT_TRIED_EVERY: this post is long enough that only {codesTried} of its {codesFound} codes were measured; the rest stayed as bb code untried, which the {target} lane renders as it is, so the post reads right but converts less than a shorter one would
A_CODE_THE_OTHER_FORMAT_DOES_NOT_CARRY: [{code}] does not survive the switch to {target}: its markup shows in the post as plain text instead of formatting it
CONTENT_THE_OTHER_FORMAT_DOES_NOT_CARRY: this post does not read the same in {target}: some of it shows as plain text instead of formatting the post
